Model comparison

Two models, line by line — the winner is visible at a glance

Select two LLMs to generate a line-by-line comparison: input/output/cache-hit prices, time-based pricing, context windows, supported modalities and features, plus an example monthly cost using the exact formula of the cost calculator. For a whole-market comparison at identical usage and how to read it, see the pricing comparison guide.

What each comparison fixes

Every pair compares: input price, output price, cache-hit price, time-based pricing rules, context window and supported modalities, plus an example monthly cost identical to the cost calculator (100 calls/day · 2,000 input / 800 output tokens per call · off-peak rates · 30% cache hit rate). Prices are official published list prices (CNY or USD per 1M tokens; USD models are converted to CNY at the reference rate for comparison — indicative only); models without a published cache price use the miss price. The example monthly cost is an estimate at that fixed usage only — it is not a ranking of capability, output quality or overall value, and does not constitute purchase advice. Method and common mistakes: How to calculate LLM API costs.
